dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: *sigh* Whenever I think about the new recruits making the same mistakes Turenna made when she was young... It just makes me even more determined to make them practice more. Failure is the mother of success, after all!

choices.text: What's up with Turenna and the newbies?

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: *sigh* They spent far too long obsessing over equipment prep and individual combat skills.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Experimenting with musket properties, honing marksmanship, looking for better uniforms, headgear, and vests... It's not wrong to pay attention to these, but once it comes at the cost of everything else...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Every member of the Maison Gardiennage values teamwork. Aside from Captain Chevreuse, who's in a class all of her own, a lone musketeer cannot hope to handle complex tasks singlehandedly.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: For example, no matter how well a musketeer has honed their marksmanship, or how good their equipment, they can only attack in one direction when breaking into a room. That leaves them open to retaliation from every other angle...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: On the other hand, if you coordinate with your squad members, each one of you can cover a different area of a room during an assault. Even if your guns aren't the best, your rate of success is dramatically increased.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Turenna enjoys providing long-distance support, but the logic is the same. A sniper who works alone will quickly be spotted by the enemy, and they'll fan out to avoid her line of sight.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Worse, if they return suppressive fire, she'll be outnumbered and outgunned. And that's not even getting into how difficult it'd be to get out alive...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Now that Turenna's gotten some real field experience, she'll get her priorities straight. It'll only be a matter of time until the rest of the new blood follows suit.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Which is to say, this wargame has been a valuable experience.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Although it may seem like neither side used the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol's equipment or combat tactics, the underlying logic behind their actions bears some similarities.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Confirming one's initial position, assessing the situation, planning the approach, and charting out an appropriate offensive strategy... Build upon these, and your chances of making mistakes in real combat scenarios will be greatly reduced!

choices.text: Reality is often stranger than movies.
Seems like you've known Turenna a long time.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Has it been that long? Maybe about four to five years...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Wait a sec, four to five years already!? I've been so preoccupied with work... How time flies.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Back then, Turenna was calling herself a rookie, all so she could push the teaching of actual rookies onto me...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: The cheek! I wonder if it was all just an elaborate ploy to evade her responsibilities...!

choices.text: Perhaps she was just being humble.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Hmm... I suppose that's just how she is. She looks up to others, and keeps her head down. She lacks confidence when dealing with new recruits...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: But that won't do! After all, she's now represented the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol in this joint wargame, so she has to be more confident, act like the veteran she is, and impart her valuable knowledge!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: I'll have a good chat with her later!

choices.text: She doesn't seem like the type to slack off...
Good luck whipping the new recruits into shape!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Don't worry, you won't have to tell me twice. I'm going to roll up my sleeves and show them the true meaning of discipline!
